# @zakkster/lite-bvh

> Zero-GC dynamic Bounding Volume Hierarchy for 2D. Flat Structure-of-Arrays layout, O(1) free-list allocation, Surface Area Heuristic insertion, iterative query that writes hits into a caller-provided `Int32Array`. **No allocations after construction.** Companion to `@zakkster/lite-aabb` (same leaf-AABB format).

## API

Single named export: `DynamicBVH2D`.

```ts
class DynamicBVH2D {
    // ALLOCATES — call at setup. maxNodes must be an integer in [1, 2^26],
    // else throws a library Error. A two-leaf tree needs at least 3 nodes.
    constructor(maxNodes: number);

    // O(log n) insert via SAH descent. Throws on capacity exhaustion —
    // atomically, before any mutation, so the tree stays valid.
    insertLeaf(leafAABB: Float32Array, data: number): number;       // returns node id

    // O(log n) remove. Heals the gap by promoting the sibling.
    // THROWS on an invalid, freed, or non-leaf (internal) handle.
    removeLeaf(leaf: number): void;

    // O(1) fast path when newAABB still contained inside fat bounds.
    // O(log n) slow path: remove, fatten by margin, re-insert.
    // THROWS on an invalid/freed handle. ALWAYS reassign your stored id.
    updateLeaf(leaf: number, newAABB: Float32Array, margin: number): number;

    // Iterative AABB-overlap query. Writes leaves' userData into outBuffer.
    // Stops early when outBuffer fills; a zero-length buffer returns 0.
    query(queryAABB: Float32Array, outBuffer: Int32Array): number;  // returns hit count

    // Debug/test only, O(n). Throws naming the first bad node, else returns
    // true. NEVER call on a hot path.
    validate(): true;

    // Read-only stats
    readonly maxNodes: number;
    readonly nodeCount: number;
    readonly root: number;       // -1 if empty
}
```

## Format

- **AABB:** `Float32Array(4)` = `[minX, minY, maxX, maxY]`. Identical to `@zakkster/lite-aabb`.
- **`userData`:** any `int32` you want returned from `query()` — typically an ECS entity id.
- **`outBuffer`:** caller-owned `Int32Array`; size for your worst-case query batch.

## The margin parameter

Leaves are stored with **fat** bounds — the entity's bounds inflated by `margin` on every side. As long as the entity's tight bounds stay inside the fat bounds, `updateLeaf` takes the O(1) fast path. When they breach, the leaf is removed, refattened, and re-inserted.

- **Sweet spot:** `margin ≈ expected_velocity × 2 frames` in world units.
- **Too small:** every move triggers re-insert.
- **Too large:** queries return more false positives.

## Sizing

- Each node is **40 bytes** across all SoA buffers.
- For N leaves you need at most 2N-1 nodes; allocate `maxNodes ≈ 4 × expectedEntities` for headroom.
- A `DynamicBVH2D(4096)` is ~160 KB.

## When to use

- 2D broadphase for collision detection, viewport culling, mouse picking.
- Spatial queries for AOE effects, vision cones, explosion radii.
- Twitch Extension overlays (under the 1 MB bundle and 60 fps budgets).
- Any 2D scene with thousands of moving entities where O(N) scans are too slow.

## When not to use

- 3D scenes — this is 2D only.
- Static-only data (no moves/inserts after build) — a flat sorted-by-Morton array can be faster.
- Sub-million-unit world spans — `Float32` precision becomes limiting.
- Workloads dominated by raycasts — not implemented yet (see roadmap).

## Algorithm

Box2D `b2_dynamicTree` ported to flat typed arrays:
- Insert: Surface Area Heuristic descent picks the cheapest sibling.
- Refit: walk parent chain, merge child bboxes into parent bbox.
- No rotation rebalancing yet — SAH descent alone produces balanced trees for typical game workloads.

## Install

```bash
npm i @zakkster/lite-bvh
```

```js
import { DynamicBVH2D } from '@zakkster/lite-bvh';
```
